title: Turkey Pies and Alibis by Wendy Meadows
description:
This week’s Novels and Nibbles features a packed B & B, a wedding just weeks away, and a dead body on a thanksgiving parade float, so much for a quiet holiday! Innkeeper Brenda Sheffield is hoping to reconnect with her estranged father when he shows up out of the blue. But when he becomes a suspect in the parade murder and her detective fiancé can’t rule him out, Brenda starts digging for answers herself. It’s a quick cozy mystery with small-town charm, family drama, and a Thanksgiving surprise no one sees coming.

We took Turkey, Pies, and Alibis a little too literally and made a Turkey Pot Pie! A whole turkey was slow braised and tucked into a creamy filling with corn, carrots, peas, green beans, and garlic, then topped with a flaky pie crust. It’s served with house-made cranberry chutney.

This dish with the Indian inspired cranberry chutney is to die for! Better have an Alibi.
